correctness.rationale: The original total Roman {2} definition implies the positive endpoints; this eliminates the total-support condition. A complete and disjoint partition into endpoint label pairs (2,2), (2,1), (1,2), (1,1), using extremal positive indices, gives the finite-sum identity for all n>=2. Geometric series prove the rational generating function; exact specialization and lowest-degree extraction prove total counts and minima. Direct exhaustive neighbor tests over 5,380,830 assignments and an independent nine-boundary-state check through n=18 corroborate all claimed formulas. Finite tests are not infinite proofs.
